line.innkeeper.greeting.prompt: If you are planning a rescue, I hope you are planning to come back for supper.

line.innkeeper.dreamcap.prompt: Orcs love honey stout. Add a silver-spotted dreamcap from the wood and they will sleep for hours. Combine them in your satchel, then slip the brew into their stew when the guard looks away.
